meeting.title: beehiiv — week 1 sync
meeting.summary: First weekly sync after the beehiiv kickoff. Agreed repo access, warehouse connection and first compile, and Redshift IP whitelisting.
action_items: Nina to grant dbt repo access via the quarry-integration GitHub team by July 3
Maya to connect the warehouse and get the dbt project compiling by July 7
Marcus to whitelist Quarry's IPs on the Redshift cluster by July 6
key_decisions: Connect against the existing dbt production target, not a fork
meeting.notes: Fresh onboarding, high energy — beehiiv wants first dashboards before their end-of-July board meeting.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Great kickoff last week. This week is about getting the plumbing in so we can compile your project. First up: repo access.

transcript.speaker: Nina Alvarez
transcript.text: Easy one. I'll get you the dbt repo access — invite to the quarry-integration GitHub team by tomorrow, July 3rd.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Perfect. Once I'm in, do we work off main or do you want us on a fork?

transcript.speaker: Nina Alvarez
transcript.text: Off main, against the existing production target. A fork would just drift.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Agreed. Then on our side — I'll connect the warehouse and get the dbt project compiling in Quarry by Tuesday, July 7th.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Webb
transcript.text: That depends on network access though — our Redshift cluster only accepts whitelisted IPs.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Right, I'll send you our static IP ranges after this call. Can you get them whitelisted before Tuesday?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Webb
transcript.text: Yes — I'll whitelist Quarry's IPs on the Redshift cluster by Monday the 6th.

transcript.speaker: Nina Alvarez
transcript.text: For context on urgency: our board meeting is end of July and I'd love the subscriber retention dashboard live for it.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: That's a realistic target if the compile lands next week. We'll scope the retention dashboard properly at next Thursday's sync rather than promise it today.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: So: repo invite tomorrow, IPs Monday, compile Tuesday. Speak Thursday.
